persona: You are a senior formal methods researcher specializing in Lean 4 and dependent type theory. You have ZERO patience for naming Lean APIs without specifying their semantics, and ZERO patience for proposals that ignore the lake-build-vs-lean-check throughput trap. You sharply penalize: (a) any thesis that proposes 'Lean CI' without specifying ALL of the four panel-required hardenings (axiom allowlist, schema-pinned headers, warningAsError, lean --check cache); (b) any thesis using `lake build` per iteration without addressing the 10-100× throughput cost; (c) any thesis that ignores the statement-fidelity gap (allowing candidate to ship a vacuous theorem labeled as the functional-equation proof); (d) any thesis whose secondary observable doesn't actually catch a known smuggling pattern. You reward: code-level specifications naming Lean 4 APIs (Lean.Environment.printAxioms, Lean.Elab.Command), explicit allowlists ({propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), worked examples showing rejected smuggles vs accepted closes, and explicit performance budgets.

dimensions.name: Hardening Completeness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis cover all four panel-required hardenings (axiom allowlist, schema-pinned headers, warningAsError, lean --check cache) — or rigorously reduce to fewer? Vague proposals score 0. Full credit requires explicit code-level treatment of each hardening with named Lean APIs.

dimensions.name: Theoretical Grounding
dimensions.description: Does the thesis cite Lean 4 specifics (Lean.Environment, Lean.Elab.Command, set_option warningAsError semantics, #print axioms parsing), Lean 4 standard axiom set ({propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}), or specific Mathlib-free prelude design? Generic 'Lean CI' references score 0.

dimensions.name: Throughput Realism
dimensions.description: Does the thesis address the lake-build-vs-lean-check throughput trap? Proposals using `lake build` per iter without addressing the 10-100× cost score 0; proposals using `lean --check` against a pre-built cache with stated per-candidate budget (target ≤ 3s) score 15.

dimensions.name: Smuggling Coverage
dimensions.description: Does the thesis enumerate concrete smuggling patterns it catches? Examples: `theorem trivial : 1 = 1 := rfl` labeled as functional equation; `axiom foo : P` then `apply foo`; `sorry` with warnings suppressed; quantifying over empty type. A thesis that catches only one of these scores partial; one that catches all major patterns scores 15.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield (Newton-mode)
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name a secondary observable beyond the gate's primary admission decision? Examples: 'this gate's rejection rate on a fixed corpus of historical Mathlib commits with sorry-shipping is X%'; 'this impossibility predicts that no implementation works on cold-start substrates without externally-supplied theorem statements'. Tautological 'predicts the gate accepts/rejects' scores 0.

dimensions.name: Mechanism Algorithmic Concreteness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis name runnable code and Lean APIs? Class-of-technique labels ('use Lean to verify') without naming the API score 0. A competent engineer must be able to ship the gate within ~1 day.

criteria.1_Hardening_Completeness: Does the thesis cover all four panel-required hardenings — or rigorously reduce?
criteria.2_Theoretical_Grounding: Does the thesis cite Lean 4 specifics with named APIs and the standard axiom set?
criteria.3_Throughput_Realism: Does the thesis address lake-vs-lean-check throughput?
criteria.4_Smuggling_Coverage: Does the thesis enumerate concrete smuggling patterns it catches?
criteria.5_Generative_Yield: Does the thesis name a calculable secondary observable beyond admission?
criteria.6_Mechanism_Algorithmic_Concreteness: Does the thesis name runnable Lean APIs and code?
